suggestions.notes: Primary sources directly authored by Ramesses II are scarce and typically exist as inscriptions on monuments or papyri, which are not readily available in digitized text formats on platforms like Wikisource or Project Gutenberg. These inscriptions are usually studied through scholarly translations and analyses.
